Install locking nut.

Shape headstock. Drill 3 more 10mm holes for the tuners. Sand and paint. Install gold Grover mini locking tuners.

Remove frets. Install new gold frets.

Dye a dark stripe down the centre of the fretboard.

Remove plastic inlays and install gold metallic ones.

Strip polyurethane finish off body with heatgun. Fill neck pickup cavity. Paint body black.

Install gold Emg 81 bridge pickup.

Install all new electronics ( volume and tone pots and output jack)

Install gold Floyd Rose bridge.

Gold output jack plate.

Gold mounting plate on neck.

Gold pickup frame.

All gold hardware.
